GET /api/reports/retention-policy.notes: Tenant-scoped setting for new saved runs only. The handler requires platform.report.retention.manage. Seven years is a product default, not a universal legal period.

POST /api/reports/retention-policy.notes: A tenant report-retention manager must record a reason; changes apply to new runs only and do not rewrite existing dates or holds.

GET /sentinel/api/record-profile/{record.notes: RoPA and DPIA field definitions require Privacy module access. Jurisdiction references are researched but not approved legal wording; users must review them before filing.

GET /ai-governance/api/assessment-profil.notes: AI impact assessment field definitions require assessment view access. The profile is an internal assurance template, not an independent decision or approved statutory checklist.

GET /sentinel/api/reports/{kind}.notes: RoPA and compliance score documents need module access; the breach register also needs sentinel.breach.manage, checked in the handler as the breach list does. Records are limited to the caller's business units.

GET /sentinel/api/audit-export.notes: Each part of the evidence pack needs the capability of its own list (breach, request, impact assessment, vendor); a part the caller may not open is left out and named in the README.

GET /sentinel/api/dpias/{dpia_id}/docume.notes: One DPIA as PDF or Excel. Requires sentinel.dpia.manage, scoped record access, and an audited download. Related records and Vault files follow the reader's access.

GET /bcm/api/plans/{plan_id}/document.notes: One continuity plan as PDF or Excel. Requires BCM module access, scoped plan access, and an audited download. Covered processes are scoped separately.

GET /ai-governance/api/assessments/{asse.notes: One AI impact assessment as PDF or Excel. Requires ai_assessment.view, scoped assessment access, and an audited download. Hidden linked records are omitted.

GET /aria/documents/{doc_id}/workbench.notes: Implemented page; ARIA module access is required.

GET /aria/api/documents/{doc_id}/workben.notes: Implemented document state endpoint; ARIA module access is required.

GET /api/capability-state/ai.notes: Reports provider configuration without exposing keys; other dependency states have dedicated endpoints.

GET /aria/api/documents/{doc_id}/compare.notes: Scoped comparison of retained policy versions and approval history. Build awaiting final regression validation.

POST /bcm/api/exercises/{ex_id}/actions.notes: Creates canonical Task Board corrective action. Build awaiting final regression validation.

POST /bcm/api/exercises/{ex_id}/actions/.notes: Reviewer verifies completed task with scoped evidence. Build awaiting final regression validation.

GET /bcm/api/exercises/{ex_id}/report.notes: Downloads retained and SHA-256-checked after-action snapshot. Build awaiting final regression validation.

POST /bcm/api/exercises/{ex_id}/transiti.notes: Authorized BCM exercise lifecycle transition. Build awaiting final regression validation.

GET /bcm/api/exercises/{ex_id}/workspace.notes: Scoped BCM exercise lifecycle workspace read model. Build awaiting final regression validation.

GET /api/capability-state/connectors/{na.notes: Role-first connector configuration state without webhook URLs. Build awaiting final regression validation.

GET /api/capability-state/{area}.notes: Role-first state for authoring, conversion, ERM scan, export and email. Build awaiting final regression validation.

GET /api/admin/diagnostics.notes: Sanitized diagnostic probes and platform-only aggregate state frequency. Build awaiting final regression validation.

GET /api/my-work.notes: Scoped federated My Work feed with bounded keyset paging; source caps are reported. Build awaiting final regression validation.

GET /my-work.notes: My Work page. Federated source state and filters are built. Build awaiting final regression validation.

GET /readiness/api/findings.notes: Scoped data-readiness findings and licensed rule coverage. Build awaiting final regression validation.

GET /ai-governance/api/systems/{applicat.notes: Scoped eligible-person search for G7 human oversight. Pilot acceptance is pending.
Reads versioned human oversight arrangements. This does not determine legal conformity.

PUT /ai-governance/api/systems/{applicat.notes: Saves a new oversight draft version with scoped responsibility. Pilot acceptance is pending.

POST /ai-governance/api/systems/{applica.notes: Independent review of the current oversight version. Legal rule content remains disabled.
